topic: Best Microbreweries in Bangalore: How to Choose, and Where BLR Fits by Occasion
covers: Defines the criteria that actually separate microbreweries (on-site freshness, food depth, group and corridor fit, outdoor scale, occasion) instead of publishing another ranking. Presents BLR's six-outlet system as the worked answer across every axis, with no competitor leaderboard. Proof carried: single Siebel-trained brewmaster Umang Nair brewing on-site at all six outlets, roughly 30,000 to 35,000 litres brewed chain-wide per month, a 50-50 food-beer split. Commercial through-line: owns the broadest category term in the city and routes readers to the outlet page that matches their need.

topic: The Best Beer Gardens in Bangalore: Where to Drink Craft Beer Outdoors
